summary: Achieving true success and accelerating your career requires **increasing the surface area of your life** rather than hiding away in isolation, meaning you must actively **engage with the real world** through in-person meetings, networking, and taking physical action. Instead of relying on passive online job applications or hiding behind screens, you should **say yes to new adventures**, build deep expertise in specific subjects, and **actively scout and connect with influential people** who already embody the level of success you desire. Ultimately, you can transform your personal and professional trajectory in just a few years by **embracing discomfort and friction**, stacking consistent tiny wins, and **replacing complaining with relentless, positive execution**.
